title: Vet clinic
description: Kenney-style vet clinic, 13 x 8 m: cream walls with teal trim and big teal-framed windows, a low slate gable roof with a white paw-print sign over the front, a slate front door. Built-in interior for the cutaway: mint checker waiting room wrapped round a pale exam room (exam table, sink, pegboard), two low animal benches facing each other in the waiting room, and down the east side the vet's flat: wood floor, a closet and a slate-checker bathroom across a little hall at the back. roof / walls (4 faces + 7 partitions, origins on the ground) / interior.
